summary: Final DT-8 Docking and hit clustering readout for Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS using client-supplied X-ray co-crystal coordinates. The analysis identified a solvent-facing substitution opportunity carried into the next chemistry cycle, with pocket-water uncertainty retained in the design rationale.

slides.title: Design question and outcome
bullets: Where can substitution be explored without relying on an uncertain pocket-water interpretation?
Crystallography-based docking identified a solvent-facing substitution opportunity.
Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS carried that opportunity into its next chemistry cycle.
The design hypothesis remains subject to experimental testing.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Coordinate and ligand provenance
bullets: The client supplied in-house X-ray co-crystal coordinates for its stress-kinase ligands.
Docking and hit clustering used those coordinates as the structural reference.
Input and preparation records are linked to {{PRJ0014:lims_id}}.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Engagement chronology
bullets: Analysis started 08 Sep 2025.
Interim interpretation: 13 Oct 2025.
Final design readout and accompanying report: 13 Nov 2025.
The ranked design rationale belongs to {{PRJ0014:project_id}}.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Coordinate data acceptance
bullets: Check coordinate identity and the correspondence between modelled ligand and supplied chemistry.
Review alternate conformations and unresolved regions near the pocket.
Distinguish observed atoms from preparation choices in the analysis notebook.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Ligand preparation
bullets: Preserve parent identity through protonation and conformer preparation.
Record stereochemical assumptions rather than silently filling ambiguous assignments.
Inspect the prepared ligand against the supplied co-crystal geometry.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reference pose as an anchor
bullets: Use the supplied co-crystal pose to constrain interpretation of docking proposals.
Do not favour score improvement when it requires an implausible pose departure.
Keep observed geometry distinct from a predicted design pose.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Docking and hit clustering
bullets: Compare proposed designs under a consistent preparation route.
Cluster related ideas so the ranked list exposes redundant changes.
Use docking scores in kcal/mol as model outputs, not measured affinity.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Pocket-water question
bullets: Which design conclusions depend on retaining a water in the prepared pocket?
An observed water position does not establish its free-energy contribution.
Avoid treating a water-mediated contact as an assured affinity gain.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Water-retention sensitivity
bullets: Retained-water preparation: examine the geometry of water-mediated contacts.
Preserve the provenance of observed and added atoms.
bullets_right: Omitted-water preparation: examine whether the design interpretation changes.
Flag proposals dependent on a particular preparation choice.
slides.notes: Compare assumptions rather than assigning a numerical water-displacement benefit. No numerical docking table is supplied with this readout.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Conserved-water interpretation
bullets: Assess conservation in the supplied coordinate context.
Coordinate appearance alone does not establish occupancy in every experimental condition.
Preserve uncertainty where alternative interaction networks are plausible.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Solvent-facing substitution vector
bullets: The identified opportunity points towards solvent-facing substitution.
Explore that vector in the next chemistry cycle.
Retain the co-crystal anchor when judging whether a proposed substituent fits the design rationale.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Design priorities
bullets: Prioritise substitutions that test the solvent-facing hypothesis cleanly.
Keep water-dependent alternatives distinguishable from the central design direction.
Avoid interpreting the ranked design list as an experimentally established potency order.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Practical chemistry handover
bullets: Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS took the solvent-facing opportunity into its next chemistry cycle.
Carry pose rationale and water assumptions with the proposed chemistry.
Confirm actual sample identity before linking future assay results to a modelled design.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: What the model cannot settle
bullets: Docking does not resolve the energetic cost of water displacement by itself.
Substitution may affect properties outside the binding pocket.
A plausible pose does not establish cellular activity or selectivity.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Experimental decision after synthesis
bullets: Compare the new material with an appropriate parent reference under matched conditions.
Interpret measured activity alongside sample quality and relevant properties.
Return discordant observations to both ligand preparation and pocket-water assumptions.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Final recommendation
bullets: Use the solvent-facing substitution opportunity to guide the next chemistry cycle.
Keep pocket-water uncertainty explicit in each design rationale.
Close {{PRJ0014:project_id}} with the computational recommendation and await experimental evidence.
Dr T. Zawiernicki | 13 Nov 2025
